name.description: The name of the windows Service being reported.

description: The Windows Service Receiver is a receiver for scraping information about the state of services running on a Windows machine.

windows.service.status.description: Gauge value containing service status as an integer value.
windows.service.status.extended_documentation: Gauge values map to service status as follows: 0 - Failed to retrieve service status, 1 - Stopped, 2 - Start Pending, 3 - Stop Pending, 4 - Service Running, 5 - Continue Pending, 6 - Pause Pending, 7 - Service Paused
